rule.message:
All degree-seeking students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements .
All freshmen in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001: First-Year Experience.
At least 20 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
View  Four-year Plans  for the College of Science and Engineering. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

While not an admission requirement, students interested in the earth sciences major may want to consider taking ESCI 1001 or another ESCI 1xxx introductory course. Up to 4 ESCI 1xxx credits can be used toward the major's Technical Electives requirement. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
